div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1608px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2057px; margin-left: 267px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #232F3E; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Flows (1/2)
1 DNS lookup of eventide.creasy.club (Cloudflare delegates the name to Route 53, which answers with the ALB)
2 HTTPS request, in through the internet gateway — the WAF inspects it, TLS ends at the ALB with the ACM certificate
3 ALB → ingress-nginx NodePort (the ALB is built by Terraform, not by Kubernetes)
4 ingress routes by path: / → web · /api/events · /api/regis (+WebSocket) · /api/auth · /api/payment
5 /files/* is rewritten by the ingress to S3 through the gateway endpoint; only public/* is readable
6 event, registration, payment ask auth to validate the session cookie (get-session, cached in Redis 60 s)
7 auth, event, registration, payment → RDS Proxy → RDS (one database, one role, pool of 4 per pod)
8 same four → ElastiCache over TLS with an AUTH token (session cache, event cache, live-seat pub/sub)
9 S3 reads/writes (avatar, cover, gallery) from either tier use the S3 gateway endpoint
10 same four enqueue mail (template + props) on SQS, through the sqs interface endpoint

text.tspan: 1 DNS lookup of eventide.creasy.club (Cloudflare delegates the name to Route 53, which answers with the ALB)
2 HTTPS request, in through the internet gateway — the WAF inspects it, TLS ends at the ALB with the ACM certificate
3 ALB → ingress-nginx NodePort (the ALB is built by Terraform, not by Kubernetes)
5 /files/* is rewritten by the ingress to S3 through the gateway endpoint; only public/* is readable
6 event, registration, payment ask auth to validate the session cookie (get-session, cached in Redis 60 s)
7 auth, event, registration, payment → RDS Proxy → RDS (one database, one role, pool of 4 per pod)
8 same four → ElastiCache over TLS with an AUTH token (session cache, event cache, live-seat pub/sub)
9 S3 reads/writes (avatar, cover, gallery) from either tier use the S3 gateway endpoint
10 same four enqueue mail (template + props) on SQS, through the sqs interface endpoint

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1248px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2057px; margin-left: 1907px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;

div.div:
Flows (2/2)
11 mail-worker long-polls, renders the React Email template, deletes; 5 failed receives → DLQ
12 mail-worker → NAT → internet gateway → Gmail SMTP (dry-run log when no App Password)
13 payment → NAT → Stripe (checkout, verify, refund)
14 Stripe → webhook, over the public https site (the endpoint registered in Stripe)
15 auth → NAT → Google (sign-in)
16 web asks event for the page's title / image (Open Graph head)
17 make up/down = terraform apply, state in S3 (permanent: VPC, ECR, S3, SQS, secrets, DNS · nightly: EKS, NAT, endpoints, RDS, Proxy, Redis, ALB, WAF, alarms)
18 push to main: build + push images (a), helm upgrade + kubectl + db-migrate (b), read secrets (c)
19 kubelet pulls images from ECR through the ecr.api / ecr.dkr endpoints; ingress-nginx and metrics-server come from the ECR mirrors
20 15 CloudWatch alarms (ALB 5xx / health / latency, RDS, Proxy pinning, Redis, DLQ, node CPU, WAF burst) → SNS; dashboard eventide
Colours
━ user request · ━ service call · ━ data store · ━ mail (SQS) · ━ external API
┅ deploy / control · ┅ DNS / certificate / WAF setup · ▭ orange dashed box = not live yet

div.div:
Differences from the target architecture (AWS_Diagram_Tool.jpg)
CloudFront → ALB + WAF (CloudFront is denied in the Learner Lab; the WAF is not in the target) · NLB → ALB · Shield: only the automatic Shield Standard (Advanced is denied) · not production-grade, by lab constraint: single AZ, no RDS backups (the database is rebuilt every session), pods use the 4-hour session credentials (no IRSA), EKS API public, WAF and ALB logging off, platform up only during sessions (the $50 cap).

text.tspan: CloudFront → ALB + WAF (CloudFront is denied in the Learner Lab; the WAF is not in the target) · NLB → ALB · Shield: only the automatic Shield Standard (Advanced is denied) · not production-grade, by lab constraint: single AZ, no RDS backups (the database is rebuilt every session), pods use the 4-hour session credentials (no IRSA), EKS API public, WAF and ALB logging off, platform up only during sessions (the $50 cap).
